html_source: Poster made from an engraved print for the pantomime Harlequin and The House that Jack Built, produced at the Sadler's Wells Theatre in London, 1850-1851. Print is held in the Granger Historical Picture Archive, Brooklyn, New York. Source: www.walmart.com.
